claims.exact_statement: For every finite K,A,B >= 0 there is a genuine Boolean physical split with L > K*d + A*V_post + B*M_inf, where q_W=(Ghat(W)^2+Hhat(W)^2)/2, e_W=(Ghat(W)-Hhat(W))^2/4, theta_W=e_W/q_W, d=sum e_W, L=sum q_W*h2(theta_W), V_post=sum q_W*(theta_W-d)^2, and M_inf=sum_i(Inf_i(G)-Inf_i(H))^2.

claims.exact_statement: For every eta>0, let C_eta be the class of nonconstant genuine Boolean functions with full Walsh support, I(F)<=eta, max_i I_i(F)/I(F)<=eta, and Pr(F=-1)<=eta. Then sup_{F in C_eta} L(F)/I(F)=C_L, where C_L is the unrestricted optimal constant for the complete signed downward functional. For every nonconstant seed g, the explicit one-point-surgery plus r_m=ceil(sqrt(m)) sparse-activation sequence satisfies L(F_m)/I(F_m)->L(g)/I(g).

claims.exact_statement: For every finite nonconstant Boolean source, a maximum-ratio physical descendant is critical. If a disjoint tensor product F of nonconstant Boolean factors is eta-critical under every physical descendant and w_j=I(f_j)/I(F), then R(F)-(1-w_j)eta/w_j <= R(f_j) <= R(F)+eta and every descendant u of f_j has R(u)<=R(f_j)+eta/w_j. Consequently an exact critical tensor product is precisely a product of equal-ratio critical factors.

eta-criticality under every nonconstant physical descendant

claims.exact_statement: For every nonconstant Boolean f and relevant coordinate i, with R=H(f)/I(f), child averages Hbar,Ibar, d_i=I_i(f), and Delta_iH=H(f)-Hbar, one has Hbar-R Ibar=R d_i-Delta_iH. Hence Delta_iH/d_i<R exposes a nonconstant physical child of ratio greater than R. Every descendant-critical f satisfies Delta_iH>=R I_i(f) for all i. A minimum-dimensional counterexample to H<=C I is tensor-prime and satisfies Delta_iH-CI_i(f)>=H(f)-CI(f)>0 for every i.

claims.exact_statement: Let f be a nonconstant genuine Boolean function, R=H(f)/I(f), D_R(g)=R I(g)-H(g) for physical descendants, and s_R(g,i)=Delta_i H(g)-R I_i(g). For every finite physical restriction tree T rooted at f, with reach weights w_v, sum over leaves w_l D_R(f_l) equals sum over internal nodes w_v s_R(f_v,i(v)). If f is descendant-critical, this sum is nonnegative. At any node with D_R=0 each local slack is nonnegative, with equality exactly when all nonconstant children retain ratio R. For a tree continued to constants the total signed slack is exactly zero.
review_obligations: A090 or A094 reconstruct the edge identity, tree cancellation, descendant-critical corollary, and complete-tree zero-sum endpoint.

Positive root slack can accumulate through a complete physical tree without signed cancellation.
